label: Allied Telesis AT-x530-18GHXm
description: Allied Telesis AT-x530-18GHXm stackable L3 switch: 16x 100M/1G/2.5G/5G PoE++ RJ-45 ports (1000 W budget; 60 W on all 16, 90 W on 11), 2x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 200 Gbps switching fabric, 149 Mpps.

poe.note: 1000 W total from two fixed 500 W supplies. Vendor budget table: 15.4 W PoE to 16 powered devices, 30 W PoE+ to 16, 60 W PoE++ to 16, but 90 W PoE++ to only 11 of the 16 - so the per-port figure modelled here is 60 W, the rate every port can hold at once. All 16 ports are 802.3bt PSE ports, PD classes 0-8, Mode A and Mode B.

fabric.note: Vendor switching-fabric figure (forwarding rate 149 Mpps), the full-duplex aggregate of the port rates: 2 x (100000 Mbit/s of line rate).

notes: 1U full-width: 441 x 421 x 44 mm, 6.7 kg. No front-panel figure for this model was found in the guides checked, so the 1-16 / 17-18 numbering follows the family pattern confirmed by the VCStack guide, which names 17/S1 and 18/S2 as the stacking ports. The 16 multi-gigabit copper ports are ports 1-16, the two SFP+ cages are ports 17 and 18 (17/S1 and 18/S2, stacking by default). 130 W with no PoE load, 1400 W fully loaded. The 90 W figure is a budget consequence, not a port limit: 11 x 90 W is 990 W and a twelfth port at 90 W would overrun the 1000 W ceiling. Console is the front-panel RJ-45 RS-232 port (AlliedWare Plus default 9600 8-N-1, no flow control; the switch ships with the manager/friend logins), reached with the RJ-45-to-DB-9 cable in the box or an AT-VT-Kit3 USB-to-serial cable. The management panel also carries a USB port and the eco-friendly button; neither is a network interface, so neither is modelled. Numbers: the x530 Series datasheet SPECIFICATIONS and Power and Noise tables and the model page at https://www.alliedtelesis.com/us/en/products/switches/x530-series; port numbering from the x530 Quick Installation Guide (https://www.alliedtelesis.com/sites/default/files/file/2022-03/ati-x530-english-qig.pdf) and, for the 10/18/28GSX/DP port fronts, the VCStack installation guide (https://www.alliedtelesis.com/sites/default/files/documents/installation-guides/ati_x530_vc_stacking_ig.pdf).
